  "say": "Grace, Jack's right to check. Your pale run's end faces right, but Jack's coming down from the nose. Look at which way the last few dominoes lean before you extend, and if they need turning, bridge from Jack's end. Jack, keep going toward Priya's run.",
  "to": ["Grace", "Jack"],
  "eagerness": 5,
  "point": [18.5, 12],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Fish, side view. Pad is Sofia's; don't take it. Stroke 1 (nose stub) and stroke 2 (top edge, Grace) are done and connected. Stroke 3 (bottom edge): Maya carries it to the tail; Priya is tracing the middle-to-Maya section. Gap split: Grace closes pale-run end to the nose junction (check facing, Jack's concern); Jack takes nose junction to middle of bottom edge, joining Priya's run. Bottom run's true end: small end just below the nose, facing down-left, nothing ahead. Fin 6 = Leo. Fin 7: Priya or Tom, still unresolved (Hana asked them to say now). Sam wants 4 and 5 off first. Eye = Leo. Grace holds off the dorsal fin. Waiting on Maya's flag, then check the tail notch gap. I stay off stroke 3 and off the pad."
